content: Ntɔn ndaa ayà iler in'twaŋ bàfàlääm itɛk, bi banswà ikyàyöb naa bi iwe anà ngyööb. Ngyööb ifàpà ngaal, wɛɛ ukwen bàkyer afàtɔŋ.
Isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy akasii naa nde ayöb undiir mwɛy, nde ŋàtàyöb anki asànaa bàkyer ayöb.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur akwen Nzam, Nzam akyun'yöb.
Abun, nkye ngye an'kwo adi in'twaŋ bàfàlääm itɛk? Bi ikyàyöb naa itɛk u mɛɛn kyà undiir a bunàbun anà nzam asin watɛy, Nzam wà mwɛy.
Ntɔn, ndandaa bye anà indiir bàfàbel naa bànzam, itàkal u du, itàkal u mɛɛn, asànaa bànzam anà bàmwol bà mbɔɔn,
wɛɛ akà bi, Nzam wà mwɛy, Taa anà Nkyer a indiir byanswà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi wà ntɔn Nde, anà Mwol mwɛy, Yɛsu Klistɔ. Indiir byanswà bàkyer u mbwo a Nde anà bi ibà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a Nde.

Wɛɛ baar banswà ngyööb yatɛy. Bamwɛy bàkyàyii u nsyääl aba yà itɛk tii ŋàbawà, mudyà in'twaŋ a ibɔɔn asànaa naa ndandaa mya bàlääm itɛk, anà an'kyän aba mà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, màŋàbwà ŋingyäy.
Kyekà, bya kà isaa ifàsin bi tsütsü a Nzam anki: isàkal naa bi idi anki bya, bi undiir ayàkyà bwà watɛy, isàkal naa bi kan'dyà bya, undiir aŋàsöön iyàwal bi watɛy.
Wɛɛ làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ naa nsaay abɛ ayi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n abulà mbwo a mbweel ntɔn aŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa ngye bàmaman, ngye mbuur awe anà ngyööb, u mɛsà uboo a ndwà a nzam a itɛk, nkye an'kyän ande iyun'syen anki, nde ŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là, mudyà in'twaŋ bàlääm mupà ibɔɔn akà itɛk.
Abun, ŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là awà, ntɔn ngyööb angye, wà un'tɔŋ awà kàkü Klistɔ ntɔn nde.
Mukyer man'be abun akà atɔŋ abɛ anà muyɔɔl mpem aba yà gyɔ̈ɔ̈là, bɛ làbàmukyer man'be akà Klistɔ.
Kyakin, isàkal naa isaa mwɛy ibwiy un'tɔŋ amɛ, mɛ in'yàfàdyà anki akà ikikye in'twaŋ ntɔn mukɔɔn abwiy un'tɔŋ amɛ.
